### setNote

Write or replace the rich-text note of an entity (state, province, burg, marker, river, route, zone, culture, religion, biome, good, regiment…). Unsafe markup is stripped before storing, never executed. Read notes with map_list kind=notes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no | Note key from map_list kind=notes, e.g. "state:3" (regiment: "regiment:3-2") |
| `entity_type` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg`, `marker`, `river`, `route`, `feature`, `zone`, `journey`, `market`, `regiment`, `addedLabel`, `culture`, `religion`, `biome`, `good` | no | Entity type: state, province, burg, marker, river, route, feature, zone, journey, market, regiment, addedLabel, culture, religion, biome, good |
| `entity_id` | integer (min 0) | no | Entity id inside its type |
| `entity_sub` | integer (min 0) | no | Only for regiments: the regiment's own id inside its state |
| `html` | string | yes | Note HTML from the notes-editor subset; scripts, iframes, event handlers and javascript: URLs are stripped |

### appendNote

Append HTML to an entity's existing note (same safety rules as setNote).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no | Note key from map_list kind=notes, e.g. "state:3" (regiment: "regiment:3-2") |
| `entity_type` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg`, `marker`, `river`, `route`, `feature`, `zone`, `journey`, `market`, `regiment`, `addedLabel`, `culture`, `religion`, `biome`, `good` | no | Entity type: state, province, burg, marker, river, route, feature, zone, journey, market, regiment, addedLabel, culture, religion, biome, good |
| `entity_id` | integer (min 0) | no | Entity id inside its type |
| `entity_sub` | integer (min 0) | no | Only for regiments: the regiment's own id inside its state |
| `html` | string | yes | Note HTML from the notes-editor subset; scripts, iframes, event handlers and javascript: URLs are stripped |

### removeNote

Delete an entity's note entirely (the entity itself is untouched).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no | Note key from map_list kind=notes, e.g. "state:3" (regiment: "regiment:3-2") |
| `entity_type` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg`, `marker`, `river`, `route`, `feature`, `zone`, `journey`, `market`, `regiment`, `addedLabel`, `culture`, `religion`, `biome`, `good` | no | Entity type: state, province, burg, marker, river, route, feature, zone, journey, market, regiment, addedLabel, culture, religion, biome, good |
| `entity_id` | integer (min 0) | no | Entity id inside its type |
| `entity_sub` | integer (min 0) | no | Only for regiments: the regiment's own id inside its state |

### setMapLore

Set the world's lore: its name (downloaded files take it), the current year and era of its calendar (history and battle reports are dated by them) and the author's free description. At least one field must be given; read them with map_summary lore.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | no | Map name |
| `year` | integer | no | Current year, may be negative |
| `era` | string | no | Era name, such as "Winter Era" |
| `era_short` | string | no | Era short form, such as "WE" (abbreviated from the era if omitted) |
| `description` | string | no | Author's description of the world; pass an empty string to clear it |

### addZone

Create a zone (a named area with its own label, colour or hatch, and population) over cells, exactly like painting one in the zones editor. Cover: `cells` (cell ids, e.g. gathered from map_list) or `selection` (a map_select id — the natural companion: map_select circle/rect/state, then addZone). Zones appear with layer zones (map_layers).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Zone name, also its description |
| `type` | string | yes | Free label such as Invasion, Disease, Quarantine, Hunting grounds |
| `cells` | integers | no | Cell ids to cover (give `cells` OR `selection`, not both) |
| `selection` | string | no | Selection id from map_select to cover |
| `color` | string | no | CSS colour (hex or a colour name, normalized like the editor) or hatch fill url(#hatch0) to url(#hatch41); default: next hatch like the editor |
| `hidden` | boolean | no | Start hidden (labels and shapes exist but are not drawn) |

### updateZone

Change a zone: name, type, colour or hatch fill, and/or visibility. At least one field must be given.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zone` | integer (min 0) | yes | Zone id (map_list kind=zones) |
| `name` | string | no | New name (also the zone's description) |
| `type` | string | no | New free type label |
| `color` | string | no | CSS colour (hex or a colour name, normalized like the editor) or hatch fill url(#hatch0) to url(#hatch41) |
| `hidden` | boolean | no | true hides, false shows again |

### setZoneCells

Replace the cells a zone covers: `cells` (cell ids) or `selection` (a map_select id), exactly one of them. All ids are checked before anything changes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zone` | integer (min 0) | yes | Zone id (map_list kind=zones) |
| `cells` | integers | no | New cell ids (give `cells` OR `selection`, not both) |
| `selection` | string | no | Selection id from map_select |

### removeZone

Delete a zone (its cells and population elsewhere on the map are untouched).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `zone` | integer (min 0) | yes | Zone id (map_list kind=zones) |

### regenerateZones

Regenerate the event zones (invasion, rebels, proselytism, crusade, disease, disaster, eruption, avalanche, fault, flood, tsunami) from the current states, cultures and religions, exactly like map generation does. All existing zones are replaced.

_No parameters._

### setDiplomacy

Set a bilateral relation, its inverse (Vassal/Suzerain), and record the change in the chronicle.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | yes | Subject state |
| `targetStateId` | integer (min 1) | yes | Other state |
| `status` | one of: `Ally`, `Friendly`, `Neutral`, `Suspicion`, `Enemy`, `Unknown`, `Rival`, `Vassal`, `Suzerain` | yes | Relation from subject to target |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `to` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for targetStateId; do not supply both names |
| `relation` | one of: `Ally`, `Friendly`, `Neutral`, `Suspicion`, `Enemy`, `Unknown`, `Rival`, `Vassal`, `Suzerain` | no | Legacy alias for status; do not supply both names |

### resetDiplomacy

Regenerate all diplomatic relations and their chronicle using Azgaar's generator.

_No parameters._

### addChronicleEvent

Append an escaped chronicle event. Newlines in text separate its paragraphs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes | Event title |
| `text` | string | yes | Event paragraphs, separated by newlines |

### clearChronicle

Clear the historical chronicle without changing bilateral relations.

_No parameters._

### addRegiment

Raise a regiment or fleet. Creation takes stateId and map coordinates, returns both id forms.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | yes | Owner state |
| `x` | number | yes | Map x coordinate |
| `y` | number | yes | Map y coordinate |
| `name` | string | no | Regiment name |
| `units` | units | no | Troop composition, e.g. {infantry: 800, archers: 200} |
| `naval` | boolean | no | True for a fleet |
| `icon` | string | no | Emoji or native icon id |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |

### updateRegiment

Update a regiment's name, composition, naval flag or icon.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite military id (stateId times protocol factor plus regimentId) |
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | no | State id, together with regimentId instead of id |
| `regimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Local regiment id (zero is valid) |
| `name` | string | no | Regiment name |
| `units` | units | no | Troop composition, e.g. {infantry: 800, archers: 200} |
| `naval` | boolean | no | True for a fleet |
| `icon` | string | no | Emoji or native icon id |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for regimentId; do not supply both names |

### moveRegiment

Move a regiment without changing its base.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite military id (stateId times protocol factor plus regimentId) |
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | no | State id, together with regimentId instead of id |
| `regimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Local regiment id (zero is valid) |
| `x` | number | yes | Map x coordinate |
| `y` | number | yes | Map y coordinate |
| `rebase` | boolean | no | Also move the base (default false) |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for regimentId; do not supply both names |

### splitRegiment

Split troops in half into a new regiment of the same state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite military id (stateId times protocol factor plus regimentId) |
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | no | State id, together with regimentId instead of id |
| `regimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Local regiment id (zero is valid) |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for regimentId; do not supply both names |

### attachRegiment

Merge source troops into a target regiment, disbanding the source.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite military id (stateId times protocol factor plus regimentId) |
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | no | State id, together with regimentId instead of id |
| `regimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Local regiment id (zero is valid) |
| `targetId` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite target id, OR targetStateId + targetRegimentId |
| `targetStateId` | integer (min 1) | no | Target state |
| `targetRegimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Target local regiment id |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for regimentId; do not supply both names |
| `to_id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Legacy alias for targetId; do not supply both names |
| `to_state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for targetStateId; do not supply both names |
| `to_regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for targetRegimentId; do not supply both names |

### removeRegiment

Disband a regiment or fleet.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer (min 10000) | no | Composite military id (stateId times protocol factor plus regimentId) |
| `stateId` | integer (min 1) | no | State id, together with regimentId instead of id |
| `regimentId` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Local regiment id (zero is valid) |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | Legacy alias for stateId; do not supply both names |
| `regiment` | integer (min 0, max 9999) | no | Legacy alias for regimentId; do not supply both names |

### regenerateMilitary

Regenerate all military forces using Azgaar's generator.

_No parameters._

### assignState

Give the selected land cells to a state (0 = unclaimed). Cities in these cells change owner. State capital cells are never taken.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `state` | integer (min 0) | yes | Receiving state id (0 = unclaimed) |
| `only_neutral` | boolean | no | Only change cells whose current value is 0 (neutral/unclaimed) |

### assignProvince

Give selected land cells to a province. The province must belong to the same state as each cell. Province centres are never moved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `province` | integer (min 1) | yes | Province id |

### assignCulture

Give the selected land cells to a culture (cities in these cells take it too).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `culture` | integer (min 0) | yes | culture id |

### assignReligion

Give the selected land cells to a religion.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `religion` | integer (min 0) | yes | religion id |

### createState

Found a new state whose capital is at a map point (land). It starts with that single cell: grow it afterwards with map_select border/circle + assignState. If a city already stands there it becomes the capital, otherwise one is created. Relations with other states are set as the interface does (enemy of its old overlord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Capital x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | Capital y in map units |
| `name` | string | no | State name (generated from the local culture if omitted) |
| `color` | string | no | Hex colour (random if omitted) |

### removeState

Dissolve a state: its land becomes unclaimed, its provinces are deleted, its cities stay as independent cities (the capital loses its status).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer (min 1) | yes | State id |

### setCapital

Make an existing city the capital of its state (the old capital becomes an ordinary city). The city must belong to a state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burg` | integer (min 1) | yes | Burg id |

### mergeStates

Merge one or several states into another: their land, cities, provinces and regiments go to `into`; the merged states disappear and their capitals become ordinary cities. With as_provinces each merged state is kept as a province of `into` instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `states` | integers | yes | Ids of the states to merge away |
| `into` | integer (min 1) | yes | Id of the state that absorbs them |
| `as_provinces` | boolean | no | Keep each merged state as a province of `into` (replaces its own provinces) |
| `asProvinces` | boolean | no | Legacy alias for as_provinces; do not supply both names |

### createProvince

Found a new province at a map point (land, inside a state: neutral land cannot hold one). It starts with that cell plus the neighbouring cells of the same state that are free or belong to another province (province centres are never taken); grow or reshape it afterwards with map_select + assignProvince. If a city stands on the point it becomes the province's capital.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Centre x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | Centre y in map units |
| `name` | string | no | Province name (generated from the local culture if omitted) |
| `form_name` | string | no | Form shown in the full name, e.g. 'Duchy' or 'March' (default 'Province') |
| `color` | string | no | Hex colour (a mix of the state colour and a random one if omitted) |

### createCulture

Add a new culture with its centre at a map point (land, not already a culture centre). It starts with no cells: paint some with map_select + assignCulture to make it visible. Its name base comes from a random existing culture; cities founded later in its cells will use it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Centre x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | Centre y in map units |
| `name` | string | no | Culture name (generated if omitted) |
| `type` | one of: `Generic`, `Hunting`, `Highland`, `River`, `Lake`, `Naval`, `Nomadic` | no | Generic (default), Hunting, Highland, River, Lake, Naval or Nomadic |
| `color` | string | no | Hex colour (random if omitted) |

### createReligion

Add a new religion with its centre at a map point (land, not already a religion centre). Its type (Folk, Organized, Cult or Heresy), form and deity are generated the way the interface does it; it starts with the centre cell. Grow it with map_select + assignReligion.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Centre x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | Centre y in map units |
| `name` | string | no | Religion name (generated if omitted) |
| `color` | string | no | Hex colour (generated from the parent religion or culture if omitted) |

### adjustHeight

Raise (positive delta) or lower (negative) the relief under a selection. Heights run 0-100; sea level is 20, hills about 40-60, mountains 70+. Rebuilds coast, biomes and the economy; states and cities are kept.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `delta` | integer (min -100, max 100) | yes | Height change |
| `scope` | one of: `all`, `land`, `water` | no | land = only land cells and they stay land (coastlines frozen); water = only water cells and they stay water; all (default) = no restriction |
| `rivers` | one of: `keep`, `rebuild` | no | keep (default) = rivers stay exactly as they are (names kept; they may cross new relief); rebuild = rivers, lakes and their names are regenerated from the new relief everywhere |

### setHeight

Set the relief under a selection to one height (0-100, sea level 20). Below 20 = sea, 20-25 = coastal lowland (turns water into new land), 70+ = mountains.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `height` | integer (min 0, max 100) | yes | Target height |
| `scope` | one of: `all`, `land`, `water` | no | land = only land cells and they stay land (coastlines frozen); water = only water cells and they stay water; all (default) = no restriction |
| `rivers` | one of: `keep`, `rebuild` | no | keep (default) = rivers stay exactly as they are (names kept; they may cross new relief); rebuild = rivers, lakes and their names are regenerated from the new relief everywhere |

### smoothHeight

Smooth the relief under a selection (each cell moves towards the average of its neighbours): softens cliffs and jagged coasts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection` | string | yes | Selection id returned by map_select |
| `passes` | integer (min 1, max 10) | no | Number of smoothing passes (default 1) |
| `scope` | one of: `all`, `land`, `water` | no | land = only land cells and they stay land (coastlines frozen); water = only water cells and they stay water; all (default) = no restriction |
| `rivers` | one of: `keep`, `rebuild` | no | keep (default) = rivers stay exactly as they are (names kept; they may cross new relief); rebuild = rivers, lakes and their names are regenerated from the new relief everywhere |

### shapeCone

Raise a mountain or dig a basin around a map point: height is `peak` at the centre and blends back to the existing relief at `radius`. peak above the current height = hill/mountain/island; peak below 20 = lake or sea.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Centre x (map units) |
| `y` | number | yes | Centre y (map units) |
| `radius` | number (min 1) | yes | Radius (map units) |
| `peak` | integer (min 0, max 100) | yes | Height at the centre (0-100) |
| `power` | number (min 0.3, max 4) | no | Falloff shape: 1 linear (default), >1 sharper peak, <1 broader plateau |
| `scope` | one of: `all`, `land`, `water` | no | land = only land cells and they stay land (coastlines frozen); water = only water cells and they stay water; all (default) = no restriction |
| `rivers` | one of: `keep`, `rebuild` | no | keep (default) = rivers stay exactly as they are (names kept; they may cross new relief); rebuild = rivers, lakes and their names are regenerated from the new relief everywhere |

### shapeRidge

Raise a mountain range (or dig a valley/channel) along a path: height is `peak` on the path and blends back to the existing relief at `width` from it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | [[x, y], ...] in map units, at least 2 points |
| `width` | number (min 1) | yes | Half-width of the range (map units) |
| `peak` | integer (min 0, max 100) | yes | Height on the path (0-100) |
| `power` | number (min 0.3, max 4) | no | Falloff shape: 1 linear (default), >1 sharper peak, <1 broader plateau |
| `scope` | one of: `all`, `land`, `water` | no | land = only land cells and they stay land (coastlines frozen); water = only water cells and they stay water; all (default) = no restriction |
| `rivers` | one of: `keep`, `rebuild` | no | keep (default) = rivers stay exactly as they are (names kept; they may cross new relief); rebuild = rivers, lakes and their names are regenerated from the new relief everywhere |

### addBurg

Create a city at a map point (land, free cell). Owner state, culture and size follow the cell.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | y in map units |
| `name` | string | no | Name (generated from the culture if omitted) |

### moveBurg

Move a city to another land cell. A capital cannot leave its state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burg` | integer (min 1) | yes | Burg id |
| `x` | number | yes | x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | y in map units |

### removeBurg

Delete a city. Capitals and market centres cannot be deleted.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burg` | integer (min 1) | yes | Burg id |

### editBurg

Change a city's population (number of people) and/or its features: citadel, walls, plaza (market square), temple, shanty town, port. A port needs navigable water nearby. A plaza that is the centre of a market cannot be removed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burg` | integer (min 1) | yes | Burg id |
| `population` | number (min 0) | no | Number of inhabitants, as the interface shows it |
| `citadel` | boolean | no | Has a citadel |
| `walls` | boolean | no | Has walls |
| `plaza` | boolean | no | Has a market square |
| `temple` | boolean | no | Has a temple |
| `shanty` | boolean | no | Has a shanty town |
| `port` | boolean | no | Is a port (needs a navigable water body) |

### updateBurg

Change a city's architecture and demography: population (number of people, as map_list kind=burgs shows it) and/or its features: citadel, walls, plaza (market square), temple, shanty town, port. A port needs navigable water nearby. A plaza that is the centre of a market cannot be removed. Same behavior as editBurg.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `burg` | integer (min 1) | yes | Burg id |
| `population` | number (min 0) | no | Number of inhabitants, as the interface shows it |
| `citadel` | boolean | no | Has a citadel |
| `walls` | boolean | no | Has walls |
| `plaza` | boolean | no | Has a market square |
| `temple` | boolean | no | Has a temple |
| `shanty` | boolean | no | Has a shanty town |
| `port` | boolean | no | Is a port (needs a navigable water body) |

### addMarker

Place a marker (point of interest) at a map point. `type` may be one of the interface's marker types (call map_list kind=markerTypes) such as ruins or volcanoes, or omitted for a custom marker with your own `icon` (an emoji). Turns the markers layer on.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | x in map units |
| `y` | number | yes | y in map units |
| `type` | string | no | Marker type (default custom) |
| `icon` | string | no | Emoji for a custom marker (default ❓) |
| `name` | string | no | Marker name |
| `note` | string | no | Legend text shown for the marker |

### removeMarker

Delete a marker.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marker` | integer (min 0) | yes | Marker id |

### addRoute

Draw a route through map points: roads and trails over land, searoutes over water. The line follows the points in order (add intermediate points to steer it).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | [[x, y], ...] in map units, at least 2 points |
| `group` | one of: `roads`, `trails`, `searoutes` | no | roads (default), trails or searoutes |
| `name` | string | no | Route name (generated from the places it links if omitted) |

### updateRoute

Change a route's name, group (roads, trails or searoutes) and/or lock (a locked route survives map regeneration). Give at least one field.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route` | integer (min 0) | yes | Route id (see map_list kind=routes) |
| `name` | string | no | New name |
| `group` | one of: `roads`, `trails`, `searoutes` | no | Move the route to another group |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Lock (true) or unlock (false) the route |

### splitRoute

Cut a route at one of its inner points: the route ends there and a new route of the same group goes on from the cut. Points are counted from 0.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route` | integer (min 0) | yes | Route id (see map_list kind=routes) |
| `point` | integer | yes | Index of the inner point to cut at (points are counted from 0) |

### joinRoutes

Join two routes of the same group that meet at an endpoint into one continuous route; `other` is removed. The result starts where one started and ends where the other ended.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route` | integer (min 0) | yes | Route that keeps the joined line |
| `other` | integer (min 0) | yes | Route to join into it (removed afterwards) |

### removeRoute

Delete a route.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `route` | integer (min 0) | yes | Route id |

### addRiver

Draw a river from its source to its mouth through map points (all on land; the points are joined along adjacent land cells). A river that ends in a cell of an existing river becomes its tributary. Rivers regenerated by a terrain edit with rivers=rebuild replace hand-drawn ones.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | path | yes | [[x, y], ...] source first, in map units, at least 2 points on land |
| `name` | string | no | River name (generated if omitted) |
| `flux` | number (min 1) | no | Water flow that sets the river width (default from config: a modest river). Cells that already carry more keep it |

### updateRiver

Change a river's name, type (a free label such as River, Creek or Fork), mainstem and/or width (source width and width factor). Give at least one field. parent: the river this one flows into, or its own id to make it a mainstem.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `river` | integer (min 1) | yes | River id (see map_list kind=rivers) |
| `name` | string | no | New name |
| `type` | string | no | Free type label such as River, Creek or Fork |
| `parent` | integer (min 1) | no | River it is a tributary of (its own id = mainstem) |
| `sourceWidth` | number (min 0) | no | Width at the source, in km (the mouth width follows) |
| `widthFactor` | number (min 0) | no | How fast the river widens downstream |

### removeRiver

Delete a river and all its tributaries.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `river` | integer (min 1) | yes | River id (see map_list kind=rivers) |

### moveLabel

Shift the label of a state, province, city (burg), river, route or added label by an offset: dx, dy in map units added to its automatic position (positive dx moves right, positive dy moves down). Or hide / show it, or reset it to its automatic position.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg`, `river`, `route`, `added` | yes | What the label belongs to |
| `id` | integer (min 1) | yes | Entity id (the label's own id for kind=added) |
| `dx` | number | no | Horizontal shift in map units (give dy too) |
| `dy` | number | no | Vertical shift in map units (give dx too) |
| `hide` | boolean | no | true hides the label, false shows it again |
| `reset` | boolean | no | Put the label back at its automatic position and show it (ignores dx/dy/hide) |

### regenerateEmblem

Give a state, province or city (burg) a freshly generated coat of arms: new heraldry derived from its parent's emblem, exactly like the interface's regenerate button. Shape, size and position are kept; change them with setEmblemStyle.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg` | yes | Entity kind |
| `id` | integer (min 1) | yes | Entity id |
| `kinship` | number (min 0, max 1) | no | How much the new heraldry inherits from the parent emblem (default 0.3) |

### setEmblemStyle

Change the look of an existing coat of arms without redrawing its heraldry: the shield shape (heater, round, banner, noldor...) and/or its size (1 = default; 0 hides the emblem from the map).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg` | yes | Entity kind |
| `id` | integer (min 1) | yes | Entity id |
| `shield` | one of: `heater`, `spanish`, `french`, `horsehead`, `horsehead2`, `polish`, `hessen`, `swiss`, `boeotian`, `roman`, `kite`, `oldFrench`, `renaissance`, `baroque`, `targe`, `targe2`, `pavise`, `wedged`, `flag`, `pennon`, `guidon`, `banner`, `dovetail`, `gonfalon`, `pennant`, `round`, `oval`, `vesicaPiscis`, `square`, `diamond`, `fantasy1`, `fantasy2`, `fantasy3`, `fantasy4`, `fantasy5`, `noldor`, `gondor`, `easterling`, `erebor`, `ironHills`, `urukHai`, `moriaOrc` | no | Shield shape |
| `size` | number (min 0, max 5) | no | Emblem size (1 = default; 0 hides it from the map) |

### legend

Show or hide a legend box on the map (it is saved with the map). layer: states, provinces (optionally one `state`), cultures, religions, biomes, zones, heightmap (elevation bands), temperature, precipitation, population, routes, or custom (needs `items`). The box is named by `title` (default: the layer's name); several boxes can be shown at once. Placement: `corner`, or `x`/`y` = where the box's bottom-right corner sits, in % of the map. `columns` (items per column) and `opacity` (box background) apply to every box.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of: `show`, `hide`, `hide_all` | yes | show, hide (one box) or hide_all |
| `layer` | one of: `states`, `provinces`, `cultures`, `religions`, `biomes`, `zones`, `heightmap`, `temperature`, `precipitation`, `population`, `routes`, `goods`, `markets`, `trade`, `custom` | no | What the legend explains (needed for show; for hide, picks the default title) |
| `title` | string | no | Box title; also its identity (hide with the same title) |
| `items` | string | no | custom only: "#aa3355=Label;#3355aa=Other label" (hex colour, =, label; items separated by ; or new lines) |
| `state` | integer (min 1) | no | provinces only: keep the provinces of this state |
| `corner` | one of: `top-left`, `top-right`, `bottom-left`, `bottom-right` | no | Put the box in this corner of the map |
| `x` | number (min 0, max 100) | no | Bottom-right corner of the box, % of map width |
| `y` | number (min 0, max 100) | no | Bottom-right corner of the box, % of map height |
| `columns` | integer (min 1, max 100) | no | Items per column, for all boxes (more columns = wider, shorter box) |
| `opacity` | number (min 0, max 1) | no | Box background opacity, for all boxes |

### annotate

Persistent annotations drawn over the map and saved with it (they come back after map_file load and appear in exports). add: kind text (needs x, y, text), marker (x, y, optional text beside it), line (needs path), area (needs area, filled translucent, optional text at its first point). list: every annotation with its id. remove: one by id. clear: all of them. Coordinates are map units (0 to the map's width/height).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of: `add`, `list`, `remove`, `clear` | yes | add, list, remove or clear |
| `kind` | one of: `text`, `marker`, `line`, `area` | no | add only: what to draw |
| `x` | number (min 0) | no | text / marker: horizontal position in map units (give y too) |
| `y` | number (min 0) | no | text / marker: vertical position in map units (give x too) |
| `path` | path | no | line: at least 2 [x, y] points |
| `area` | points | no | area: at least 3 [x, y] points |
| `text` | string | no | text shown (text, marker, area) |
| `color` | string | no | Colour name or hex code; default is a dark red |
| `size` | number (min 0.5, max 100) | no | marker radius, text size or line width, in map units |
| `id` | integer (min 1) | no | remove only: the annotation id from list |

### createSubmap

Destructively resample a region into a new map, undoable through map_undo. MCP saves maps/pre-submap.map before resampling. Needs explicit confirmDestructiveResample:true. Bounds are expanded to the native canvas ratio, never stretched; effective bounds are returned. Native generation density is reused. Selections and free annotations are cleared in the child.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x0` | number | yes | Left edge in map units |
| `y0` | number | yes | Top edge in map units |
| `x1` | number | yes | Right edge in map units |
| `y1` | number | yes | Bottom edge in map units |
| `confirmDestructiveResample` | boolean | yes | Must be true; use map_view/map_export inset for a non-destructive loupe |
| `rescaleBurgStyles` | boolean | no | Scale native burg icons and labels (default true) |

### rename

Rename a state, province, burg, culture, religion or river. For states and provinces `full_name` is the long form shown on the map (defaults to `name`).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | one of: `state`, `province`, `burg`, `culture`, `religion`, `river` | yes | What to rename |
| `id` | integer (min 1) | yes | Entity id |
| `name` | string | yes | New (short) name |
| `full_name` | string | no | Long name, e.g. 'Kingdom of Gazd' (states and provinces only) |

### setStateColor

Change the colour of a state (hex like #aa3355).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer (min 1) | yes | State id |
| `color` | string | yes | Hex colour, e.g. #aa3355 |

### applyStylePreset

Replace the whole visual style with a preset: one of Azgaar's built-in themes (offline files) or a custom preset saved in this browser. map_list kind=styles shows the current preset and every style value; setStyle adjusts single values afterwards.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preset` | string | yes | Preset name: default, ink, ancient, cinderwood, clean, atlas, light, pale, watercolor, frostbite, gloom, darkSeas, cyberpunk, night, monochrome, or a custom preset key from map_list kind=styles |

### setStyle

Set one value of the map's style by its path, such as "ocean.groups.base.attrs.fill" or "relief.options.density". map_list kind=styles lists the paths. Pass value: null to unset an attribute.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Style path: element[.groups.group][.attrs\|.options].name, e.g. "ocean.groups.base.attrs.fill" |
| `value` | scalar | no | The new value: text, a number or true/false. null unsets an attribute |

### setTopography

Configure native heightmap contour lines, slope hachures, hypsometric fills and terraces; show the heightmap layer and redraw immediately. Partial update only, no terrain data changes. target land (default), ocean or both. isolineFills:false requires at least contours or hachures, and maps to native line-only modes. map_layers preset=topographic selects the seven atlas layers.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | one of: `land`, `ocean`, `both` | no | Height bands to configure; default land |
| `scheme` | string | no | Native registered color scheme (bright, light, natural, green, olive, livid, monochrome); unknown names refused |
| `contours` | boolean | no | Show smooth elevation contour lines |
| `contourInterval` | integer (min 2, max 20) | no | Contour interval in native height units (2..20) |
| `hachures` | boolean | no | Show downhill tapered slope hachures |
| `isolineFills` | boolean | no | Show colored hypsometric fills (false = line-only; requires contours or hachures) |
| `terracing` | number (min 0, max 20) | no | Native terrace shadow strength, 0 disables |

## Selection shapes (`map_select`)

| Shape | What it selects |
|---|---|
| [`circle`](#shape-circle) | Cells whose centre is within a radius of a map point |
| [`rect`](#shape-rect) | Cells whose centre is inside a rectangle |
| [`polygon`](#shape-polygon) | Cells whose centre is inside a polygon |
| [`cells`](#shape-cells) | An explicit list of cell ids |
| [`state`](#shape-state) | All cells of a state (0 = unclaimed land) |
| [`province`](#shape-province) | All cells of a province |
| [`border`](#shape-border) | `depth` layers of cells of state `from` (0 = unclaimed land), counted inward from its border with state `to`. Typical use: select it, then assign it to `to` to extend `to` into `from` |
| [`ring`](#shape-ring) | `depth` layers of land cells just OUTSIDE a state, whoever owns them (neighbours or unclaimed). Typical use: select it, optionally restrict with a rect (combine_op intersect) to extend towards one direction, then assignState to that state |
| [`rim`](#shape-rim) | `depth` layers of cells just INSIDE a state along its border with other land (not coasts). Typical use: hand its border strip to a neighbour with assignState |
| [`flood`](#shape-flood) | Connected cells around a start cell that share a property with it |

### shape-circle

Cells whose centre is within a radius of a map point

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes | Centre x (map units) |
| `y` | number | yes | Centre y (map units) |
| `radius` | number (min 1) | yes | Radius (map units) |

### shape-rect

Cells whose centre is inside a rectangle

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x0` | number | yes | Left (map units) |
| `y0` | number | yes | Top (map units) |
| `x1` | number | yes | Right (map units) |
| `y1` | number | yes | Bottom (map units) |

### shape-polygon

Cells whose centre is inside a polygon

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | points | yes | [[x, y], ...] in map units |

### shape-cells

An explicit list of cell ids

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cells` | integers | yes | Cell ids |

### shape-state

All cells of a state (0 = unclaimed land)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer (min 0) | yes | State id |

### shape-province

All cells of a province

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `province` | integer (min 1) | yes | Province id |

### shape-border

`depth` layers of cells of state `from` (0 = unclaimed land), counted inward from its border with state `to`. Typical use: select it, then assign it to `to` to extend `to` into `from`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | integer (min 0) | yes | State losing cells (0 = unclaimed) |
| `to` | integer (min 0) | yes | State gaining cells |
| `depth` | integer (min 1, max 60) | yes | Number of cell layers |

### shape-ring

`depth` layers of land cells just OUTSIDE a state, whoever owns them (neighbours or unclaimed). Typical use: select it, optionally restrict with a rect (combine_op intersect) to extend towards one direction, then assignState to that state

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer (min 1) | yes | State id |
| `depth` | integer (min 1, max 60) | yes | Number of cell layers |

### shape-rim

`depth` layers of cells just INSIDE a state along its border with other land (not coasts). Typical use: hand its border strip to a neighbour with assignState

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer (min 1) | yes | State id |
| `depth` | integer (min 1, max 60) | yes | Number of cell layers |

### shape-flood

Connected cells around a start cell that share a property with it

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start` | integer (min 0) | yes | Start cell id |
| `match` | one of: `state`, `province`, `culture`, `religion`, `biome`, `land` | yes | Property that must equal the start cell's |
| `max_cells` | integer (min 1) | no | Stop after this many cells |

## Selection options (all shapes)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `land_only` | boolean | no | Keep land cells only (default true) |
| `only_state` | integer (min 0) | no | Keep only cells currently owned by this state |
| `combine_op` | one of: `add`, `subtract`, `intersect` | no | Combine the result with an earlier selection |
| `combine_with` | string | no | Id of the earlier selection (needed with combine_op) |
